definition: the natural state of rest at night
description: Two hamsters lie on a thick white fluffy blanket in a warm, dimly lit room strung with fairy lights. The one on the left wears round glasses and taps at a small silver laptop, still awake and working. The one on the right has a white sheet face mask over its face and a pink bow headband, and lies on its side with its eyes shut, not moving, deep in sleep while the other works on beside it.

en.question: What is the masked hamster doing?

de.answer: Er holt sich mit einer Gesichtsmaske etwas Schlaf.
de.question: Was macht der Hamster mit der Maske?

es.answer: Está durmiendo un poco con una mascarilla facial.
phrases: echar un vistazo a la cámara

fr.answer: Il dort un peu avec un masque pour le visage.
